rationale: The plan correctly identifies the paired structure and specifies ~ subject + condition in DESeq2 with the condition coefficient as the test, explicitly rejecting an unpaired two-sample test, so the design fit is strong; median-of-ratios normalization inside the model is named and pre-normalization is forbidden. QC is present (library sizes, PCA/sample distances with an expectation that subject pairing dominates an axis) but no coloring scheme is spelled out and there is no outlier or shallow-sample policy. The low-count filter is directionally right (near-zero across all samples, justified by dispersion stability) but no concrete criterion is given. The main gap is effect-size handling: BH with alpha 0.05 and 0.1 is stated, but no lfcShrink/apeglm shrinkage is mentioned despite n=5 pairs, and no LFC threshold in the test. Enrichment names a versioned WikiPathways snapshot, symbol matching, an FDR rule and leading-edge reporting, but leaves ORA-vs-GSEA unresolved, states no explicit universe and no ranking metric, and no gene-set size window; reporting covers design, thresholds, hit counts and power caveats but not software versions.
